items.title: Why Alphabet’s stock could see its worst day ever after the latest results

items.title: Marvell is reportedly close to buying Lumentum. Analysts say they see logic in a potential deal.

items.title: Consumer spending flattens out after inflation surge
items.content: Consumer spending rose sharply in September, but it largely reflected households spending more on gas and transportation after an increase in energy costs.
